hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: In a 3x3 grid, there are exactly four possible 2x2 subgrids.

hints.title: Change Requirement
hints.text: A 2x2 square can be made monochromatic with at most one modification if it currently contains zero, one, three, or four cells of a single color.

hints.title: Parity Check
hints.text: If any 2x2 square has a color count that does not equal two, return true, otherwise return false.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; 3x3 grid has constant fixed size.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify that any 2x2 subgrid with a 3-1 or 4-0 color split can be made uniform in one move.
